checks: Evaluation preparation enforces archive, project and tenant scope
Approved exact document source and authorized account duties form an idempotent draft
Foreign, unauthorized and duplicate accounts cannot become configured evaluation personnel
Independent source and configured rules display field differences and block freeze
Manual item review and exact decimal total cannot be bypassed
Untrusted formulas are rejected and purchase method is not silently changed
Qualification duties are required separately from technical reviewers
Optimistic versions and explicit business-rule confirmation guard state changes
Freeze requires its independent permission even when draft management is authorized
Concurrent retry freezes once and immutable snapshot retains document hash, account duties and exact rule data
Void preserves the frozen snapshot and new rounds never inherit a previous frozen state
Changed confirmed requirements stale the source and frozen basis without rewriting historical bytes
Confidentiality permission protects both workspace and snapshot for creators and wildcard-free managers
Authorized read-only participants may inspect preparation but cannot configure it
scope: evaluation preparation only; synthetic rules; no live scoring or regulatory certification
